facts.raw_span: 2 months of progressive right earache and headache without fever
without fever
2 weeks of mild left-sided weakness
1 week of intermittent hallucinations and nonsensical speech
left pronator drift
no obvious manifestation of external ear canal infection during endoscopy of the right ear
Erythrocyte sedimentation rate: 42 mm/h (normal, <20 mm/h)
C-reactive protein level: 25 mg/L (normal, <10 mg/L)
Glycosylated hemoglobin A1C level: 6.8% (normal, 4.3%-6.1%)
positive for anti-NMDAR antibodies (CSF titer 1:320, serum titer 1:100)
CT scan of temporal bone showed otitis media, mastoiditis, and local bone destruction in the right ear
Coronal FLAIR image demonstrated extensive area of hyperintensity with compressed right lateral ventricle

rationales.F04: Intermittent hallucinations and nonsensical speech are characteristic symptoms of Anti-NMDAR encephalitis.
rationales.F10: The presence of anti-NMDAR antibodies is a strong indicator of Anti-NMDAR encephalitis.
